abstract: BACKGROUND: The clinical importance of ovarian teratoma in anti-N-methyl-D-aspartate receptor (NMDAR) encephalitis has been established, however investigations of ovarian teratoma in patients with anti-NMDAR encephalitis remain limited. OBJECTIVE: To clarify differences in NMDAR distribution and lymphocyte infiltration in ovarian teratoma between patients with and without anti-NMDAR encephalitis. METHODS: Participants initially comprised 26 patients with ovarian teratomas. NMDAR distribution and lymphocyte infiltration in ovarian teratomas were examined using immunopathological techniques. Clinical, laboratory, and radiological data were compared between patients showing the features of encephalitis. Anti-NMDAR antibodies in the serum and cerebrospinal fluid were also measured in encephalitis patients. RESULTS: Neuronal tissues were obtained from ovarian teratomas in 22 patients (after excluding 4 patients who did not satisfy the inclusion criteria), and the presence of NMDA receptor subunits was revealed in all patients. Lymphocyte infiltration was more frequent in the encephalitis group (n = 3) than in the non-encephalitis group. In particular, dense B-lymphocyte infiltration near neural tissues was observed in the encephalitis group. CONCLUSIONS: Differences in lymphocyte infiltration in ovarian teratomas between anti-NMDAR encephalitis and non-encephalitis patients suggest the immunological importance of the ovarian teratoma as the site of antigen presentation in anti-NMDAR encephalitis.
abstract_ja: 背景：抗N-メチル-D-アスパラギン酸受容体（NMDAR）脳炎における卵巣奇形腫の臨床的重要性は確立されているが、抗NMDAR脳炎患者の卵巣奇形腫に関する検討はいまだ限られている。目的：抗NMDAR脳炎の患者と非患者の間で、卵巣奇形腫におけるNMDAR分布とリンパ球浸潤の違いを明らかにすること。方法：対象は当初、卵巣奇形腫の患者26名であった。卵巣奇形腫におけるNMDAR分布とリンパ球浸潤を、免疫病理学的手法を用いて検討した。脳炎の特徴を示す患者間で、臨床、検査、画像データを比較した。また、脳炎患者の血清および脳脊髄液中の抗NMDAR抗体を測定した。結果：卵巣奇形腫から神経組織が22名の患者で得られ（組み入れ基準を満たさなかった4名を除外）、全患者でNMDA受容体サブユニットの存在が認められた。リンパ球浸潤は、非脳炎群よりも脳炎群（n = 3）で頻度が高かった。特に、脳炎群では神経組織近傍に高密度のBリンパ球浸潤が観察された。結論：抗NMDAR脳炎と非脳炎患者の卵巣奇形腫におけるリンパ球浸潤の違いは、抗NMDAR脳炎において抗原提示の場としての卵巣奇形腫の免疫学的重要性を示唆する。
